P01.rationale: There is no founder or person used as a dominant human anchor; the page contains only text and a faint background texture.

P05.rationale: No case studies are present on this page, so there are no client portraits to evaluate.

P07.rationale: There is no social-proof apparatus such as a press wall or review grid visible on the page.

P10.rationale: No oversized decorative typographic elements like giant ghost numerals are present; only standard headers exist.

P11.rationale: There are no data-visualisations or charts on this page to evaluate.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense and magazine-quality, utilizing the full sheet with a subtle texture rather than appearing sparse.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present throughout the page, avoiding flat blankness.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page to evaluate for treatment or readability of overlaid text.

P16.rationale: There are no device or product mockups shown on the page.

N07.rationale: The imagery is not generic stock; it consists of a specific paper texture and typographic layout rather than photos.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace as the page is filled with text blocks and background texture.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on a busy photo without scrim because there are no photos present to cause this issue.
